passage.label: An-Nisa — O People of Scripture do not exceed limits in religion say nothing about Allah except truth; Messiah Isa son of Maryam only messenger of Allah and His Word directed to Maryam and spirit from Him; believe in Allah and messengers do not say Three desist better for you; Allah only one God exalted above having son; to Him belongs heavens earth sufficient as Disposer of affairs; Messiah would not disdain being servant nor angels near; whoever disdains worship arrogant He gathers all to Himself; believers righteous deeds rewards in full plus increase from bounty; disdainers arrogant painful punishment no protector helper; O mankind proof came from Lord sent down clear light; believers holding fast to Allah admitted mercy bounty guided straight path; ruling on kalalah: man dies no child has sister half inheritance; he inherits if she no child; two sisters two-thirds; siblings male female male share of two females; Allah makes clear lest you go astray Allah Knower of all things

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَا تَغۡلُواْ فِي دِينِكُمۡ وَلَا تَقُولُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَقَّۚ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُۥٓ أَلۡقَىٰهَآ إِلَىٰ مَرۡيَمَ وَرُوحٞ مِّنۡهُۖ فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۖ وَلَا تَقُولُواْ ثَلَٰثَةٌۚ ٱنتَهُواْ خَيۡرٗا لَّكُمۡۚ إِنَّمَا ٱللَّهُ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥٓ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٞۘ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلٗا
لَّن يَسۡتَنكِفَ ٱلۡمَسِيحُ أَن يَكُونَ عَبۡدٗا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَۚ وَمَن يَسۡتَنكِفۡ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَكۡبِرۡ فَسَيَحۡشُرُهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ جَمِيعٗا

فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمۡ أُجُورَهُمۡ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَنكَفُواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فَيُعَذِّبُهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَكُم بُرۡهَٰنٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَأَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ نُورٗا مُّبِينٗا
فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱعۡتَصَمُواْ بِهِۦ فَسَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَةٖ مِّنۡهُ وَفَضۡلٖ وَيَهۡدِيهِمۡ إِلَيۡهِ صِرَٰطٗا مُّسۡتَقِيمٗا

يَسۡتَفۡتُونَكَ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفۡتِيكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡكَلَٰلَةِۚ إِنِ ٱمۡرُؤٌاْ هَلَكَ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٞ وَلَهُۥٓ أُخۡتٞ فَلَهَا نِصۡفُ مَا تَرَكَۚ وَهُوَ يَرِثُهَآ إِن لَّمۡ يَكُن لَّهَا وَلَدٞۚ فَإِن كَانَتَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَلَهُمَا ٱلثُّلُثَانِ مِمَّا تَرَكَۚ وَإِن كَانُوٓاْ إِخۡوَةٗ رِّجَالٗا وَنِسَآءٗ فَلِلذَّكَرِ مِثۡلُ حَظِّ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِۗ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ أَن تَضِلُّواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمُۢ

mainSubject.label: O People of Scripture do not exceed religious limits speak only truth about Allah; Isa ibn Maryam is messenger of Allah His Word cast to Maryam and spirit from Him not divine; believe in Allah and all messengers do not say Three desist; Allah one God exalted above having son; sufficient as Wakeel; Isa and angels would never disdain servitude; arrogant disdainers gathered for punishment; believers righteous deeds rewarded fully with increase; clear proof and light sent down; holding fast to Allah earns mercy bounty guidance; kalalah inheritance ruling: sister half brother inherits two sisters two-thirds male share of two females; Allah clarifies to prevent straying

notes: Pass A Nisa passage 19/19. Concludes surah with three distinct blocks: (1) Christological correction addressing People of Scripture - precise definition of Isa as messenger/Word/spirit, explicit rejection of Trinity and divine sonship; (2) Servitude theology - Isa and angels model willing submission vs arrogant disdain; (3) Kalalah inheritance - final legislative ruling closing the surah's extensive family-law section. Ghuluww (excess) identified as root error. Wakeel (Disposer of affairs) frames divine sufficiency.
